run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable and print its average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_with_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure function performance
create_benchmark_for_function: create a benchmark using time_func that warms up and times any zero-argument callable
refactor_time_func_for_logging: refactor time_func to return the measured time instead of only printing it
summarize_time_func_usage: summarize time_func which runs warmup calls then measures average ms per iteration
